title: Medical Officer, General Physician & Other Posts Recruitment
age_limit: Maximum 65 years as on the date of advertisement publication
summary: Chief Medical Officer, Budaun has invited applications for recruitment to 30 Medical Officer and General Physician posts under the National Health Mission on a contractual basis. Eligible candidates may apply through registered/speed post by 27 November 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Telemedicine/Teli Consultation HUB District Hospital Budaun: M.B.B.S. Degree Certified Degree from recognized Institution by MCI with Registration From Council of the State/Gol.

NP-NCD (NPCDCS) General Physician: MD (Medicine) / MBBS or equivalent degree from an institution recognized by National Medical Council with Registration From Council of the State/Gol and at least 1 year of experience in a hospital.
Maternal Health MBBS Lady Medical Officer: M.B.B.S. Degree Certified Degree from recognized Institution by MCI with Registration From Council of the State/Gol.

District Hospital Strengthening Programme (DHS) EMO: MBBS degree from recognized University/Institution with Registration in State Medical Register of Indian Medical Register and minimum 1 year experience in Emergency Ward of any 100 Bedded hospital preferable.
NUHM PM-ABHIM Medical Officer (MBBS): M.B.B.S. Degree Certified Degree from recognized Institution by MCI with Registration From Council of the State/Gol.

how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form and desired format from the official website https://budaun.nic.in/.
Fill out the application form with required educational, caste, residential, registration, and experience certificates.
Affix a postal stamp worth Rs. 55/- on the self-addressed envelope.
Send the complete application solely through registered or speed post to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Budaun on or before 27 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.
